title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: lreduction
text:
l-reduction
l-reduction
(definition)
Definition:
A
Karp reduction
that preserves approximation properties of
optimization problems
.
See also
NP-complete
,
Turing reduction
,
Cook reduction
,
many-one reduction
,
polynomial-time reduction
.
